limitations: Source amplitude, receiver noise, threshold offset and AM depth are explicit hypotheses, not a qualified input circuit.
Two declared downstream noise allocations; stationary white-equivalent noise in 1 kHz–8 MHz.
Input AM at 1 MHz; cyclostationary additive-noise modulation omitted.
Source PM passes with unity gain; loaded sideband dispersion, stage power/startup and supply correlation unqualified.
Absolute static propagation delay omitted; no latency or input-circuit qualification.
input_noise_reference.source_peak_interpretation: Gain-equivalent ideal-ground parameter only; physical amplitude is physical_source_peak_v.

frontend_nonlinearity.scope: Ten-percent peak cubic gain reduction is an assigned model-validity screen, not a compression specification.

coupled_load_clock.scope: Unique ordered local root continuations; extra crossings outside the brackets are not independently excluded.

adc.scope: Predictive conditional charge/settling/decision recurrence, not fitted silicon. Effective CDAC charge uses absolute code steps and dissipative switching; return-charge reuse, capacitor mismatch and comparator regeneration time are unmodeled. Input acquisition uses linear endpoints; half-LSB midpoint convention is assigned. The fixed comparator interval is an allocation, not demonstrated metastability performance.

observation.scope: Continuous capture delivered to external acquisition receiver; no oracle DATA alignment.

receiver.scope: Shared loaded source/input/supply spectrum and 236 mA mode budget. Assigned instantaneous early-gain rail sensitivity; fixed NF/IIP3 and ideal linear filter internals. ADC uses causal trial decisions, limited reference recovery and finite acquisition/DAC settling; pole/current/noise hypotheses are unqualified, with no mismatch or comparator-regeneration model. Known DATA training/ideal boundaries, no real preamble, CFO search, AGC or packet/PER qualification. Finite RF record does not qualify emissions or continuous host service.

load_resolution.scope: Local reference recharge port only, superposed with host ripple at full planning DC. Positive source charge is conserved; sink current receives no supply-energy credit. Assigned 200 ps supply-current pole requires an internal charge path; not a validated buffer. FFT guards, finite grid and linear fixed PDN do not qualify physical peak current or broadband transistor noise. Coupled tied-return REF_IN voltage is exposed; the delivered-clock consumer must separately solve perturbed threshold events.

scope: Matched single-ended and 20% aligned-mismatch paired input under full internal switching and causal SAR feedback. 240 mA, 500 pF, current package target, 1 V source, negative 0.025 ps/mV sensitivity. Preselected seed 431, unknown arrival 137 samples and -120 kHz CFO; paired no-wanted control. Real legacy preamble plus diagnostic coded HE20 DATA, not a valid HE packet: known DATA training, fixed gain, no HE fields/AGC/sample-rate ppm or PER qualification. Three cases per frequency; not all seeds, signs or mismatch corners.
